name: firm.query_value_name_fmt
purpose: List numeric firmware original values and names.
side_effects_assessment: Only reads local firmware/RAM data and formats UART output; no persistent update or external transmission.
output_completeness: Full table listing may exceed the earlier reliable bulk UART size. Preserve raw bytes and verify reported counts before treating the listing as complete; one command per line.
capture_note: First physical attempt of this reviewed formatter. Other full-table formatters showed malformed output; preserve this reply and validate its rows rather than claiming completeness from a prompt.
